hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_BRANCH} | cut -d "/" -f 2` GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_COMMIT} | cut -c1-7`
cp /usr/local/docker-config/httpd/httpd.env .env
if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo ".env file not found" exit 1 fi
if [ "$build_spec_config" = "true" ]; then echo "Checking out build_spec from GitHub and using its configuration.json" if [ -z "$release_control_repo" ]; then echo "ERROR: release_control_repo is not set." exit 1 fi BUILD_SPEC_REPO="$release_control_repo" BUILD_SPEC_BRANCH="${release_control_branch:-main}"
# Clone the repo to a temp directory tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BUILD_SPEC_BRANCH" "$BUILD_SPEC_REPO" "$tmpdir" if [ -f "$tmpdir/configuration.json" ]; then cp "$tmpdir/configuration.json" ./src/lib/assets/configuration.json echo "Copied configuration.json from build spec repo." else echo "ERROR: configuration.json not found in build spec repo." exit 1 fi rm -rf "$tmpdir" elif [ -n "$custom_configuration_json" ]; then echo "Using custom configuration.json" cp "$custom_configuration_json" ./src/lib/assets/configuration.json elif [ -f "/var/jenkins_home/workspace/Check For Updates/configuration.json" ]; then echo "Replacing the Config file from build spec" cp "/var/jenkins_home/workspace/Check For Updates/configuration.json" ./src/lib/assets/configuration.json else echo "Using default configuration.json" fi
[ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/httpd/terms.html" ] && cp "/usr/local/docker-config/httpd/terms.html" ./src/terms.svelte
sed -i "s/sourcemap: .*,/sourcemap: ${SRC_MAPS},/" vite.config.ts
if [ -f $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/httpd/custom_httpd_volumes ]; then export CUSTOM_HTTPD_VOLUMES=`cat $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/httpd/custom_httpd_volumes` fi docker stop httpd hpds || true
docker build --build-arg http_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg https_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg no_proxy="$no_proxy" \ --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg NO_PROXY="$no_proxy" \ -f Dockerfile -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT} . docker tag hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT} hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:LATEST
docker rm httpd || true docker run --name=httpd --restart always --network=picsure \ -v "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR"/log/httpd-docker-logs/:/app/logs/ \ -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/httpd/cert:/usr/local/apache2/cert/ \ -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/httpd/httpd-vhosts.conf:/usr/local/apache2/conf/extra/httpd-vhosts.conf \ $CUSTOM_HTTPD_VOLUMES \ --env-file /usr/local/docker-config/httpd/httpd.env \ -p 80:80 \ -p 443:443 \ -d hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:LATEST \ || exit 2
docker start hpds
